Dassault

Dassault Mechanical & DraftSight Division — SOLIDWORKS Ecosystem, 2D DWG Licensing Policies & Enterprise Migration Alternatives

By GstarCAD Academy Engineering Editorial Board (Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.) Reviewed by GstarCAD Academy Editorial Team Last reviewed 2026-10-26 Editorial Process

1. Division Focus: Mainstream MCAD & the DraftSight Commercial Shift

Operating out of Waltham, Massachusetts under the Dassault Systèmes umbrella, the SOLIDWORKS and DraftSight division manages mainstream mechanical product design, PDM workgroup vaulting, and 2D DWG maintenance tools. In 2011, the division launched DraftSight (built atop the Graebert ARES engine) as a free 2D DWG tool to attract AutoCAD users into the SOLIDWORKS ecosystem.

However, in 2019, Dassault terminated free DraftSight activation, shut down legacy perpetual standalone activations, and forced commercial customers onto recurring annual subscriptions or high-tier Enterprise network bundles. This abrupt policy reversal prompted thousands of sheet-metal fabricators and machine builders to evaluate true perpetual alternatives like GstarCAD Professional & Mechanical.

C++ Plugin PortingRequires rewriting to Graebert DRX/C++ headers.Native GRX SDK with direct ObjectARX class & method parity.

3. Integrating SOLIDWORKS 3D Assemblies with GstarCAD 2D Production

Engineering departments running SOLIDWORKS for 3D part modeling routinely pair it with GstarCAD for plant layout, electrical schematics, and CNC laser DXF nesting. By exporting flat patterns with Bend Lines mapped to distinct DWG layers and running GstarCAD's OVERKILL and JOIN commands, fabrication teams achieve zero-gap toolpaths at a fraction of subscription CAD costs.

5. Enterprise Co-Existence, Migration & TCO Optimization Protocol

In production supply chains where upstream 3D models or BIM containers originate from SOLIDWORKS & DraftSight Division (Waltham, MA, USA) platforms, engineering IT directors optimize total cost of ownership (TCO) by deploying a tiered seat architecture centered on GstarCAD 2027 and DWG FastView:

  • Verified Data Exchange Pipeline: Replace expiring DraftSight subscriptions seamlessly with GstarCAD 2027 Perpetual Licenses; batch-clean SOLIDWORKS exported sheet-metal flat-pattern DXFs using GstarCAD OVERKILL for CNC laser cutting.
  • Eliminating Redundant Seat Rentals: Rather than purchasing high-cost authoring subscriptions for project managers, site engineers, estimators, CNC operators, and quality inspectors who primarily review geometry or annotate 2D DWG/DXF sheets, organizations equip 70%–80% of their workforce with GstarCAD Perpetual Floating Licenses (GstarLM) and FastView 3D.
  • Automated Database Hygiene Before Transmittal: Prior to archiving project deliverables or importing external vendor DWG exports into corporate PDM/CDE vaults, run GstarCAD's batch script sequence (-PURGE RegApps → OVERKILL → AUDIT Yes → INDEXCTL = 3) to guarantee sub-second opening times and zero proxy object corruption.
